basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old gamer and anime enthusiast based in Austin, Texas. I've been a Dragon Ball fan since I was a kid, and Dragon Ball Legends is my go-to mobile game. When I'm not playing games, I'm usually watching online critiques or playing co-op games like 'Raft' with my friends. I work as a graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to indulge in my hobbies during late evenings. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to dive deep into my interests without distractions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid understanding of Dragon Ball Legends, gained through countless hours of gameplay and active participation in online discussions. My knowledge also extends to other anime and gaming communities, bolstered by self-teaching and interaction with fellow fans. I often watch content from creators like MauLer to gain different perspectives on storytelling and game mechanics.
